headline: Exchange Intake Falls To 979.2 Million Dollars From 1,384.4 Million As Gate Drops To 9.1 Million
narrative: Clean-asset intake across 79 venues fell to a 979.2 million dollar inflow, 0.3592 percent of the 272.6 billion dollars held there excluding each venue's own token, from a 1,384.4 million dollar inflow at 0.5078 percent. Binance accounts for 772.3 million dollars of the current intake, down from 850.4 million, Deribit rose to 200.9 million from 178.5 million, and Bitfinex fell to 189.8 million from 200.9 million, while Gate fell to 9.1 million from 193.3 million, Bitstamp's outflow widened to 140.9 million from 131.1 million, and OKX posted a 72.1 million dollar outflow. The pipe sums the 24-hour change in dollars held on the venues excluding each exchange's own token, so the lower print means less clean-asset value arrived than on the prior reading.
author: jordan
